snippet.title: Terminal Shift - Official Gameplay Trailer [ Indie-Credible Showcase 2026 ]
snippet.description:
You are trapped in a deserted terminal, which has been twisted into a terrifying looping nightmare. Gather the access code for the boarding gates and escape an endless airport. Terminal Shift is a psychological horror game set in a deserted airport terminal, which has been twisted into a terrifying looping nightmare. Escape by gathering numbers for the access code and surviving encounters with a threatening entity.

Official Steampage:

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3856670/Terminal_Shift/
